steps: Created ReplicatedStorage.VanguardConfig ModuleScript: threat-budget waves + archetype cost/stat table + 4 cardinal gate angles
Created ServerScriptService.VanguardSiege Script: budget->roster builder, staggered burst spawn across rotating gates, registry-based wave-clear via Humanoid.Died/removal, victory print
Disabled the pre-existing ServerScriptService.RoundLoop so only VanguardSiege drives waves
Verified both scripts compile and roster builder terminates/composes per wave via run_luau

recipe.text: Distinct RoundLoop-family system 'VanguardSiege': each wave spends a THREAT BUDGET across weighted enemy archetypes (grunt/runner/brute) rather than a fixed count, releasing them in staggered bursts through 4 cardinal spawn gates. Wave-cleared is detected from a live enemy registry counting REAL deaths (Humanoid.Died + model removal), so clearing requires player combat. No auto-kill/test hook (gate-blocked). Prints [Vanguard] tags for start, intermission, each spawn, wave clear, and VICTORY. Reuses ServerStorage.EnemyTemplate (has NpcAI). Parked nothing; disabled RoundLoop (Disabled=true) as a reversible edit.
